notes: Verified via Wayback Machine snapshot of udyamregistration.gov.in (the official Udyam portal). 4 pages, digital-native PDF. O.M. No. 5/2(1)/2020-P&G/Policy dated 17.07.2020, signed by A.K Tamaria, Deputy Director, Office of DC (MSME), Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi. This is the foundational Udyam Registration O.M. that formally replaced Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) with Udyam Registration Certificate with immediate effect from 1 July 2020. Supersedes the November 2015 KVIC circular (IN-KVIC-2015-0001) that had adopted UAM for PMEGP unit registration. Tier 1 priority #2 from the acquisition roadmap. Contains 3 Udyam keyword mentions. Directly relevant to PMEGP because all PMEGP-assisted units must now obtain Udyam Registration instead of UAM.
